mapper.select: SELECT cc.calendar_cell_id, cc.class_at , c.class_id, c.class_name, cd.class_detail_id, cd.student, cd.class_subject, cd.memo, cd.teaching_unit, cd.learned, cd.good_point, cd.issue, cd.comment FROM calendar_cells cc LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.calendar_cell_id = cc.calendar_cell_id LEFT JOIN class_details cd ON cd.class_id = c.class_id ORDER BY cc.class_at

SELECT cc.calendar_cell_id, cc.class_at , c.class_id, c.class_name, cd.class_detail_id, cd.student, cd.class_subject, cd.memo, cd.teaching_unit, cd.learned, cd.good_point, cd.issue, cd.comment FROM calendar_cells cc LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.calendar_cell_id = cc.calendar_cell_id LEFT JOIN class_details cd ON cd.class_id = c.class_id WHERE cc.calendar_cell_id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE calendar_cells SET class_at = #{classAt} WHERE calendar_cell_id = #{id}
